role: Block.updateTick for every block class the random tick reaches (grass, mycelium, leaves, crops, sapling with tree growth, cactus, reeds, vine, stems, cocoa, nether wart, bushes, double plants, mushrooms, ice, snow layer, farmland, redstone ore, fire via fire.c), the World light reads they use, the World.rand draws of the drops a tick or a block break spends, and the IGrowable bonemeal bodies ItemDye calls.

structs.java: BlockLeaves.field_150128_a's +-4 cube, the cells rt_leaves' search from the leaf visits (only the centre cell outlives a call)

gpu: its former globals, function statics and lazily built tables are gone (lane/gpuenv, L2): per-environment state lives in struct env (csrc/engine/env.h), per-dimension state in the replay's dims, constant tables are built before main; csrc/tests/globals.sh lists what is left
lines 258-261: statics drop_det, drop_role, drop_sink (function pointer) and drop_sink_ctx, the drop environment published per tick
lines 1494-1495, function flower_pick: static perlin flower_noise lazily initialized on first bonemeal (lazy global init)
lines 64-72 and 83-98, functions mat_is, mat_id_is, rt_light_diffuse: material and class identity decided by strcmp on names inside the tick
line 108, function rt_chunk: world_load_chunk may load or generate a chunk from inside a light read
lines 960 and 1015, functions rt_cactus and rt_reed: while loops walking down the column, bounded only by world height
lines 1575-1620, function grass_bonemeal: a for(;;) random walk, bounded by n / 16 steps per try
lines 866-917, function sapling_grow: tree growth calls the features_* generators with their own globals (features_tree_notify, features_bigtree_reset)
function block_light_do: the five neighbour reads go through block_light_raw, no recursion
notes: Checked against the oracle's TickProbe per the file header. Drops are World.rand draws plus a sink call (drop_sink); without a sink the EntityItem is not spawned. The ice melt assumes the overworld (no isHellWorld branch, line 1234) and farmland assumes no rain for canLightningStrikeAt (comment at line 1266). The Java member lists were assembled from this file's comments and a grep of the Java sources; per-member exactness is not verified here. Callers: servertick.c, blockcb.c, features_springs.c, itemuse.c (bonemeal), seedworld.c, serverreplay.c, living.c.
